scope: Evidence-backed historical URL handling for aipremiumshop.com. This registry is intentionally fail-closed: a historical URL receives a permanent redirect only when the destination is a one-to-one current equivalent. Unrelated category or homepage redirects are not treated as equivalence.

classification_definitions.REDIRECT_EXACT: Historical URL and current destination represent the same page/product/intent; a permanent redirect is required.
classification_definitions.GONE_404: Historical route has no verified current one-to-one equivalent and should remain a genuine 404/noindex unless later evidence changes the classification.
classification_definitions.REVIEW_NON_EQUIVALENT: A redirect exists or has been proposed, but current evidence does not prove one-to-one equivalence. Do not upgrade or broaden it without new evidence.
classification_definitions.KEEP_CANONICAL: Current canonical URL; do not redirect away.

rules: Never redirect a removed product, cart, checkout, account or marketing route to the homepage or /products merely to avoid a 404.
Provider-restricted informational pages may receive exact historical redirects because the destination preserves the same product identity without reviving blocked commerce.
Do not infer current commerce availability from a redirect.
A REDIRECT_EXACT entry must be represented in artifacts/aips-landing/vercel.json with permanent=true.
GONE_404 entries must not be added as redirect sources without explicit new evidence and registry reclassification.

evidence_sources.finding: Historical public sitemap explicitly published /product/{slug} versions of multiple products that now have top-level canonical product-family pages.
Current brand-page slugs intentionally use top-level canonical routes instead of generic /product/ duplicates.

Sampled historical /product/chatgpt-plus-bangladesh, /product/claude-pro-bangladesh, /product/gemini-advanced-bangladesh and /product/midjourney-bangladesh returned genuine 404/noindex while their current top-level equivalents exist.
/claude-team-bangladesh had measured Google Search demand and maps to the current Claude Pro family under the existing exact redirect decision.
